info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Hotel Rooms Upgrade-v2-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Upgrade Management API facilitates the enhancement of existing hotel room reservations. This endpoint allows users to update their current room specifications to a higher tier, optimizing guest satisfaction and experience. Commonly utilized by hotel management systems or travel agencies, this operation ensures that customers can seamlessly enhance their bookings as needed. With this API, developers can integrate dynamic room upgrade functionalities into their applications, enhancing operational efficiency and customer service.

put.summary: Upgrade a room to a higher category or class.
put.description: This endpoint allows users to upgrade an existing room to a higher category or class, enhancing their accommodation experience. Users can specify the room they wish to upgrade along with the new category they desire. Ensure all requirements and eligibility criteria are met before proceeding.
